raw.details:
About the Event:

Prompt-e-Thon is a premier three-stage hackathon combining Ideation, AI-powered Vibe Coding, Mentorship, and Prototype Development. The event offers participants a high-impact platform to transform innovative ideas into functional, real-world products with continuous guidance from industry-experienced mentors.

The event focuses on practical problem-solving, rapid prototyping, and the effective use of modern AI tools. It is aligned with the following United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):

  • SDG 8: Decent Work and Economic Growth
  • SDG 9: Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure

Round Wise Details:

Round 1: Ideation Round (Online PPT Submission)

  • Format: Online Screening.
  • Timeline: Conducted 5–6 days prior to the main event.
  • Mechanism: Participating teams submit a slide deck detailing their problem statement, proposed solution, target audience, key features, technology stack, and SDG alignment. Shortlisted teams qualify for the mentorship and development stages.

Round 2: Discord Mentorship Round (Online Sprint)

  • Format: 8-Hour Online Mentorship via Discord.
  • Mechanism: Shortlisted teams engage in interactive mentorship sessions. Mentors evaluate progress, help refine product visions, identify edge cases, and assist teams in making their solutions practical and scalable.
  • Bonus: Points earned during this round serve as a tie-breaker during the final judging process.

Round 3: Main Event (On-Ground Mentorship & Final Evaluation)

  • Location: On-Ground Venue.
  • Stage 1 (Table-to-Table Mentorship): Mentors visit each team's workstation to review prototypes and provide final feedback based on the Discord round. Teams get time to refine their builds before final judging.
  • Stage 2 (Final Evaluation & Live Demo): The judging panel conducts table visits where teams demonstrate their working prototypes, present their solution rationale, and explain their tech stack, user impact, and SDG integration.

Rules and Guidelines:

  • Eligibility & Team Size: Open to college students interested in software, AI, and product design. Teams must consist of 2 to 4 members.
  • AI & Tech Stack Policy (Vibe Coding):
    • There are no restrictions on tools or technologies!
    • Participants are free to use Generative AI tools, AI coding assistants, open-source GitHub repositories, APIs, frameworks, libraries, datasets, and low-code/no-code platforms.
    • Teams must be capable of explaining their core logic, system workflow, and prototype during evaluation.
  • Hardware & Requirements: Teams must bring their own laptops, chargers, and hardware peripherals. Teams should maintain project backups and ensure prototypes are ready for live demonstration.
  • Judging Criteria:
    • Innovation & Problem Relevance
    • Effective Use of AI & Vibe Coding Techniques
    • Prototype Functionality & User Experience
    • Feasibility, Scalability & Impact
    • Alignment with SDG 8 & SDG 9
    • Presentation & Quality of Live Demonstration
  • Code of Conduct: Respectful and professional behavior is mandatory. Plagiarism, misrepresentation, or disruptive conduct will lead to immediate disqualification.
  • Final Authority: The decision of the judging panel and organizing committee is final and binding.
Contact for Queries

  • Sagar Das — +91 97286 61379
  • Om Karakoti — +91 96259 56718
